comment: Add new destinations by appending objects to the destinations array. Keep summaries non-spoiler and player-facing.

destinations.name: Stoneward Archive
destinations.sigil: A circle of stacked stones with a single open gap.
destinations.commitment_warning: Expect to be committed for a full session once you exit.
destinations.briefing_summary: A sealed archive that answers a single question for those who endure its trials.
destinations.danger_level: Low to moderate hazards; more puzzle than peril.
destinations.story_type: A focused expedition with a clear objective and a clean return.
destinations.duration_detail: Tier I adventures are designed to resolve in one session.

destinations.name: Ember Signal
destinations.sigil: Three rising lines over a small ember mark.
destinations.commitment_warning: Once you exit, return is likely only after the arc concludes.
destinations.briefing_summary: Respond to a distant call and decide whether it is warning, invitation, or trap.
destinations.tone: Urgent and atmospheric with shifting alliances.
destinations.danger_level: Moderate threats with occasional spikes of risk.
destinations.story_type: A two-to-three session arc with branching outcomes.
destinations.duration_detail: Tier II adventures usually take two to three sessions.

destinations.name: Glass Meadow
destinations.sigil: A clean blade of grass mirrored above a horizontal line.
destinations.commitment_warning: Exiting commits the party for the rest of the session.
destinations.briefing_summary: A fragile landscape that rewrites its layout with each visit.
destinations.tone: Wonder mixed with unease and careful navigation.
destinations.danger_level: Low danger; environmental pressures and time limits.
destinations.story_type: A self-contained outing that can be revisited with changes.
destinations.duration_detail: Tier I adventures are designed to resolve in one session.

destinations.name: Warden's Passage
destinations.sigil: An arched gate set within a vertical spine of lines.
destinations.commitment_warning: Once you exit, the return window may close until the full arc is complete.
destinations.briefing_summary: A long-form mission that establishes an ongoing connection to the wider network.
destinations.tone: Grave, procedural, and heavy with consequence.
destinations.danger_level: High stakes with sustained pressure across multiple sessions.
destinations.story_type: A four-to-six session mini-campaign with lasting effects.
destinations.duration_detail: Tier III adventures span four to six sessions and may reshape later routes.
